build_tree: build an ASCII tree representation of files and directories with size and date columns
create_function_format_size: create a function that formats a size in bytes to human-readable units like KB, MB, GB
create_function_format_date: create a function that formats a datetime object to a readable date string
create_function_get_item_date: create a function that extracts a date from a repo or bucket file item
run_function_print_file_listing: run a function that prints a file listing in tree, json, quiet, or flat format
